help.title: How it works
help.subtitle: This site works with the Discord bot + the Unturned in-game plugin
help.step1Desc: Click "Sign in with Discord" on the login page
help.step2Desc: Home → Welcome Pack box → generate code → in-game → type /link <code> → link + receive welcome items + 100 Coin
help.buy3: Click the cart icon top-right → review basket → adjust qty → confirm order
help.buy4: Coin is deducted → you get a redeem code
help.buyForget: Forgot your code? See Code history
help.sell1Desc: Enter a Safe Zone → type /sell → box opens → drop items → close box → get Coin
help.sell2Desc: Walk to the box → open → drop items → close → get Coin
help.sellNote: Only items in the Shop can be sold — anything else is returned
help.p2pDesc: Trade items directly with other players for Coin. Anything in your Vault can be listed, and you set your own price.
help.p2pSell1: Open My Vaults → pick a vault → choose the item, set a price in Coin → List on market (the item is held while listed)
help.p2pSell2: Your listing appears on the P2P Market for everyone, and shows under My Listings
help.p2pSell3: When it sells, Coin lands in your balance (minus commission)
help.p2pSell4: If it does NOT sell (you cancel, it expires, or an admin closes it) you get a redeem code instead of the item back — see the note below
help.p2pBuy1: Open P2P Market → filter by item type or price range → click a listing to review seller, quality and price → Buy
help.p2pBuy2: Coin is deducted; the purchase lands in My Inventory as unclaimed
help.p2pBuy3: Open My Inventory → Claim (or Claim all) to get a redeem code → use /code <code> in-game. (Buying via the Discord Buy button gives you the code instantly.)
help.p2pNoteCommission: A commission is taken from the seller's proceeds on each sale (the buyer pays the listed price).
help.p2pNoteTtl: If a listing is cancelled, expires, or is closed by an admin, the item is NOT returned to your vault — instead a redeem code is minted (7-day expiry). Redeem it in-game with /code; if unused within 7 days the item is lost.
help.p2pNoteCancel: You find that refund code on My Listings (Show code) and it's also sent to you via Discord DM and the in-app notification bell.
help.earn2: Online in-game +10 per 5 min (must not be AFK + alive)
help.earn8: Sell on the market (60% of price)
help.earn9: Sell Bills (100% full price, no fee)
help.exampleDesc: Sentinel at 50 → buy 1 = −50 coin, sell 1 = +30 coin (50 × 60%)
help.billsDesc: Bills are like a Cash item — sold at full price, no commission
help.billsNote: Used to transfer money between players — drop in-game → whoever picks up can sell at full price
help.cmdCodeDesc: Redeem a code from the website
help.cmdItemIdDesc: Show item id of held item
help.cmdShoppinDesc: Set a 6-digit PIN to log in to the web shop with your Steam ID
help.cmdTpaReplyDesc: Accept / deny / cancel a teleport request

sys.shop: Shop & Coins — buy items with Coin; sell in-game via /sell. Check balance with /coins.
sys.p2p: P2P Market — list your own vault items for sale to other players and buy theirs.
sys.kits: Kits — claim item kits with /kit (some have a cooldown or price); list them with /kits.
sys.vault: Vault — personal item storage (/vault, /vaults); /trash discards items.
sys.homes: Homes — place a bed to set a home, then /home to teleport back (max 2 homes).
sys.tpa: Teleport (TPA) — /tpa <player> to request a teleport to someone; they accept with /tpa a.
sys.knockdown: Knockdown & revive — instead of dying you go down; a teammate holds Crouch next to you (~1m) for 8s to revive (15s bleed-out).
sys.decay: Decay protection — a generator/Tool Cupboard keeps your base from decaying; check coverage with /decay.
sys.cleanup: Auto-cleanup — dropped items vanish over time (player drops after 10 min, zombie loot after 2 min).
sys.discord: Discord — link your account for web login and notifications; get the invite in-game with /discord.
sys.weblogin: Web shop login — sign in with Discord, or with your Steam ID + a PIN you set in-game via /shoppin.

help.faq1Q: Forgot a purchased code, what now?
help.faq1A: Open Code history — all codes you've purchased are listed with status (Available / Used / Expired)
help.faq2Q: Why do I get less Coin than the price when selling?
help.faq2A: 40% commission to keep the economy balanced — sell price = market × 0.6, except Bills which pay full price
help.faq3Q: Do I earn Coin while AFK?
help.faq3A: No — movement is checked, no movement for 10 min counts as AFK; dead in-game also doesn't count
help.faq4A: Wealth tax — 2% off your balance daily at 03:00, only if Coin > 10,000 — keeps people from hoarding too long
help.faq5Q: What if the shop runs out of stock?
help.faq5A: Stock returns when players /sell items into it — pure supply-demand
